title: Offline Banner
summary: Counts changes queued while offline and stays up after reconnecting until they have actually synced, so nobody assumes their edits reached the server.
description: Connection banner that counts queued changes while offline, stays up after reconnecting until the queue has actually synced, offers Retry if the sync fails, and can warn before leaving with unsynced changes.
catches: Edits made offline that haven't synced
Reconnecting before the queue is flushed: banner stays until it is
Leaving the page with unsynced changes (guardUnload)
limits: Only shows the queue state you pass; it doesn't queue or sync anything itself
navigator.onLine can report online on a network with no internet
a11y: Hidden banner is inert so it can't take focus
Retry is a button; the syncing spinner icon is aria-hidden
server: Make queued writes idempotent so replays after reconnecting don't apply twice.
stops: Edits made offline never reached the server
mistakes: no internet but app said saved
